:::{#exr-bernoulli-loglik-contribution-logodds}
#### Log-likelihood contribution of one binary outcome in terms of the log-odds

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-loglik-contribution,
write the [log-likelihood](#def-loglik) contribution $\llik_\iobs(\prob)$
using the [log-odds](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-odds) $\logodds \eqdef \logit(\prob)$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-loglik-contribution-logodds}

Starting from @thm-bernoulli-loglik-contribution:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\llik_\iobs(\prob)
&= \outvar_\iobs \logf{\prob} + (1 - \outvar_\iobs) \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(the contribution from the theorem above)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs \logf{\prob} + \logf{1 - \prob} - \outvar_\iobs \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(distribute $\logf{1 - \prob}$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs \logf{\prob} - \outvar_\iobs \logf{1 - \prob} + \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs \paren{\logf{\prob} - \logf{1 - \prob}} + \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(collect the terms in $\outvar_\iobs$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs \logf{\frac{\prob}{1 - \prob}} + \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(log of a quotient)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs \logodds + \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(definition of $\logodds \eqdef \logit(\prob)$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
